content: It is currently uncertain how frequently individuals with diabetes will need COVID-19 booster vaccinations. While there is limited data available regarding the attitudes toward or uptake of COVID-19 vaccines among people with diabetes in the United States, healthcare providers who specialize in diabetes care are in a strong position to address any questions or concerns related to vaccination. These professionals can play a pivotal role in encouraging vaccination among diabetic patients, thereby helping to reduce the risks associated with COVID-19 infections.
